lines.text: Zendesk lists 1,800+ apps, partners, and integrations in its Marketplace. Freshdesk cites 1,200 other common business apps, so Zendesk's catalogue is larger on those figures.
lines.reason: the reader: that Zendesk's catalogue is larger

lines.text: Zendesk handles email, chat, phone, social, messaging apps, and help center in one interface. Freshdesk's own ticketing covers email, and the other channels need Freshdesk Omni.
lines.reason: the reader: that the channels require Freshdesk Omni

lines.text: Zendesk claims AI Agents can reach up to 80% automation, and says they can be set up without scripting or developers. It also provides built-in QA scoring for 100% of AI interactions.
Zendesk was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for the CRM Customer Engagement Center.
Zendesk's free trial needs no credit card, and qualified startups can get up to 2 years of Zendesk free.
Zendesk quotes larger customer numbers: more than 80,000 companies for AI service, against Freshdesk's 74,000+ businesses.
lines.reason: it says more than its facts do

lines.text: Freshdesk publishes three plan prices: Growth at $19, Pro at $55, and Enterprise at $89 per agent per month, billed annually.
lines.reason: it states a figure its facts do not (3)

lines.text: The Freddy AI Agent is included on all three plans, with the first 500 sessions complimentary. Extra sessions cost $49 per 100. The 500 sessions are limited to once per account.
The 14-day free trial gives access to the Enterprise plan, and Freshdesk offers a free signup.
Freshdesk is built for growing service teams, typically businesses of 50 to 500 employees.
lines.reason: the reader: that teams are specifically customer service teams

lines.text: Freshdesk offers parent-child tickets, ticket templates, multiple SLA policies on Pro and above, and custom dashboards on Pro and above. Built-in dashboards and report templates come on every plan.
Freshdesk Enterprise includes Freddy AI Insights, which runs root cause analysis. Freddy AI Copilot is an add-on for Pro and Enterprise.
Thomas Cook cut unresolved tickets by 37% while handling 55% more tickets with Freshdesk.
Which channels do you need to support today: email only, or also chat, phone, WhatsApp and social?
Which tools must your helpdesk connect to, and are they in each vendor's integration catalogue?
How many AI agent sessions do you expect each month? The first 500 are included once per account, and extra sessions cost $49 per 100.
Do you need multiple SLA policies or custom dashboards? Both are on Pro and above.
Would you like to test the Enterprise plan in a 14-day trial before choosing a tier?

Zendesk lists 1,800+ and Freshdesk lists 1,200+ apps, so the gap is real. Freshdesk covers Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Shopify and Mailchimp, and it has an API. Check whether the tools you use are on the list.

That's fair. Zendesk brings email, chat, phone, social and messaging into one interface. Freshdesk's ticketing is email, and Freshdesk Omni adds chat, phone, WhatsApp and social in one Command Center. So the question is whether you need those channels now.
lines.objection: Zendesk covers all channels in one place.

lines.text: That's Zendesk's own claim about what its AI Agents can achieve. Freshdesk includes the Freddy AI Agent on every plan with 500 free sessions, and you can try it in a trial on the Enterprise plan.
lines.objection: Zendesk AI promises up to 80% automation.

lines.text: Zendesk was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for CRM Customer Engagement Center. That is a real credential. I'd still compare both products on your own workflows, and Thomas Cook's 37% drop in unresolved tickets is one Freshdesk result.
